# Magisk - Plus Key

A Magisk module that lets you choose what the Plus Key does. Pick a preset (assistant, camera, screenshot, flashlight) or run your own shell command.
## Install 1. Download the latest `pluskey.zip` from the [Releases](https://github.com/naplon74/magisk-pluskey/releases) page. 2. In the Magisk app, go to Modules > Install from storage and pick the zip. 3. Reboot. That's all you need. The key works with the default action (assistant) right after the reboot. You need a rooted phone with Magisk. ## Choosing what the key does Use the companion app (see below), or run this from a root shell: pluskey list pluskey set camera pluskey custom 'am start -a android.settings.SETTINGS' The change applies on the next key press, no reboot needed. ## Companion app There is a small app in `app/` with a settings screen and a Quick Settings tile. It only runs the `pluskey` command above, so the module works fine without it. Build it from source (see below) and install the APK. ## Tested on (WITH MAGISK ROOT) | ROM / Devices | **Nord 5** | **13a** | **15** | **15R** | **Oppo Devices** | |:-------------:|:---------------------:|:-------:|:------:|:-------:|:-------:| | OxygenOS 16 | - | - | - | - | - | | OxygenOS 15 | - | - | - | - | - | | crDroid | ✅ [(12.12 Android 16)](https://crdroid.net/lexus/12) | - | - | - | - | | LineageOS | ✅ [(23.2 Android 16)](https://wiki.lineageos.org/devices/lexus/) | - | - | - | - | | AlphaDroid | ✅ [(4.7 Android 16](https://alphadroid.org/#devices) | - | - | - | - | | DerpFest | ✅ [16.2 Android 16](https://derpfest.org/devices?s=lexus) | - | - | - | - | Other phones and ROMs are untested. The module expects the Plus Key to report `BTN_TRIGGER_HAPPY32` and the key layout to be at `/vendor/usr/keylayout/gpio-keys.kl`. >[!NOTE] > I have no idea if this module would work on Oppo devices? If you any Oppo devices / OnePlus with the plus key let me know (naplon_ on discord). ## How it works A systemless overlay removes the stock mapping for the key. A small root service listens for the key press and runs the action you chose. ## Build from source Module (needs `zip`): ./build.sh This writes `pluskey-.zip` in the repo root. ## Credits Made by naplon74. Requires Magisk by topjohnwu.
readmeHTML:
Magisk - Plus Key

A Magisk module that lets you choose what the Plus Key does. Pick a preset (assistant, camera, screenshot, flashlight) or run your own shell command.

Install

  • Download the latest `pluskey.zip` from the [Releases](https://github.com/naplon74/magisk-pluskey/releases) page.
  • In the Magisk app, go to Modules > Install from storage and pick the zip.
  • Reboot.

    • That's all you need. The key works with the default action (assistant) right after the reboot.

    You need a rooted phone with Magisk.

    Choosing what the key does

    Use the companion app (see below), or run this from a root shell:

    pluskey list

    pluskey set camera

    pluskey custom 'am start -a android.settings.SETTINGS'

    The change applies on the next key press, no reboot needed.

    Companion app

    There is a small app in app/ with a settings screen and a Quick Settings tile. It only runs the pluskey command above, so the module works fine without it. Build it from source (see below) and install the APK.

    Tested on (WITH MAGISK ROOT)

    | ROM / Devices | Nord 5 | 13a | 15 | 15R | Oppo Devices |

    |:-------------:|:---------------------:|:-------:|:------:|:-------:|:-------:|

    | OxygenOS 16 | - | - | - | - | - |

    | OxygenOS 15 | - | - | - | - | - |

    | crDroid | ✅ (12.12 Android 16) | - | - | - | - |

    | LineageOS | ✅ (23.2 Android 16) | - | - | - | - |

    | AlphaDroid | ✅ (4.7 Android 16 | - | - | - | - |

    | DerpFest | ✅ 16.2 Android 16 | - | - | - | - |

    Other phones and ROMs are untested. The module expects the Plus Key to report BTN_TRIGGER_HAPPY32 and the key layout to be at /vendor/usr/keylayout/gpio-keys.kl.

    >[!NOTE]

    > I have no idea if this module would work on Oppo devices? If you any Oppo devices / OnePlus with the plus key let me know (naplon_ on discord).

    How it works

    A systemless overlay removes the stock mapping for the key. A small root service listens for the key press and runs the action you chose.

    Build from source

    Module (needs zip):

    ./build.sh

    This writes pluskey-.zip in the repo root.

    Credits

    Made by naplon74. Requires Magisk by topjohnwu.
